paragraphs: I am fascinated by what allows us to thrive in this life. Can I be playful and drive results? Can I keep my joy and perform? From an early age on, I rejected the idea of either or. That we either get serious and create results, or we are joyful but won't get anything done. I see many people in high-stakes positions falling into the belief that we have to choose. That their private wants and the carrier can't get together.

For over seven years, I've been alongside people navigating growth, decisions, and transitions that often don't have clean answers, where the founder wants to nourish their private life, but work seems to demand everything. Or the CEO who is lost in task management and has accepted that this is it now! Yet it slowly becomes more about going through the motions than being fully alive. I'm ICF PCC-certified, with training in many coaching methodologies, leadership coaching, ACT therapy, business development, and contemplative practice.

The work I bring draws from a longer arc. I've run my own businesses, hired, fired, opened, and closed. I've worked as a professional dancer and choreographer across Europe, trained in somatic practice, shiatsu, and martial arts, and logged several thousand hours in meditation. I've led retreats, taught on stages and in studios, and coached clients internationally for the past eight years. All of it means that when you're in the room with me, I'm not looking at just one dimension of your challenge and vision. Together, we work on the whole person, the whole business, and your whole life.

I live between the Alpstein and the Bodensee with my wife Jae, where we enjoy time with family, and long conversations about life and whatever excites us right now. I write regularly and have a deep interest in philosophy, science, business, and the human condition.
